basis.title: General depreciation rates (IR265), July 2021
basis.by: Inland Revenue (Te Tari Taake), New Zealand
basis.label: Manholes
basis.note: Printed page 46. Manholes, service not stated. Buildings and structures category. Printed DV 4%, SL 3%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.

open_questions: Every source here is a published planning, design or accounting life. None is observed replacement data.
Some maintenance intervals come from TM 5-692-1, an Army manual for mission-critical (C4ISR) facilities; they may be tighter than typical commercial practice.
